data.want: 飲食店で料理と飲み物を運ぶ配膳ロボットを作りたい。お客さんのすぐそばを歩く速さで動き、飲み物をこぼさないようにしたい

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 段差に当たるときの速さ
requirements.basis: A design condition (HIRAKU's default value), set for the strength check of the step. It is not taken from a standard or a catalogue, so it has no outside source. What it gives, by the K2 calculation for the demo vehicle (offroad-4w-v1, two people and cargo): the front wheel force at the step is 3.6 times (100 mm step, 5.7 kN against 1.6 kN) to 4.4 times (250 mm step, 17.6 kN against 4.0 kN) the force of pushing up from rest

requirements.name: 路面・床と摩擦係数
requirements.basis: assumption: the friction coefficient between the wheel and a dry indoor floor (tile, wood, carpet), 0.5, HIRAKU's own value, not read in any source. The floors themselves are the ones of the JARI robot stability test facility's course, p.1, https://img.jari.or.jp/v=1740017440/files/user/pdf/stability_tests_of_robots_and_robotic_devices_2020.pdf; read 2026-11-03 in a source check (that page lists the surfaces, not a coefficient)
requirements.note: タイル・木・カーペットの床。摩擦係数は資料で確かめていない

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: an indoor floor (tile, wood, carpet) is taken as ISO 8608 class A, the smoothest class; not read in any source for floors (ISO 8608 is for roads). It is only the input the fatigue builder needs

requirements.name: 縦の坂
requirements.basis: バリアフリー法施行令の傾斜路 1/12 (= 8.33 %), 第19条, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1/lawdata/418CO0000000379; read 2026-11-03 in a source check. 製品の定格は 5 度以下 (Pudu BellaBot), https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot (this part not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: Bear Robotics Servi Plus の敷居 (1/2 in), Servi Plus page, https://www.bearrobotics.ai/servi-plus; read 2026-11-03 in a source check
requirements.note: 床の凹凸は LG CLOi ServeBot の 5 mm、ISO 7176-2 の試験は 15・25 mm も

requirements.name: 通る幅
requirements.basis: Keenon の製品ページの最小通路 (T8 0.55 m・T10 0.59 m・T9 0.70 m) の上の端, https://www.keenon.com/en/product/T9 (read 2026-11-03 in a source check; it recorded only the T9 page address). The earlier value 0.80 m is on none of the pages
requirements.note: 建物の廊下は 1.2 m 以上 (バリアフリー法施行令)

requirements.name: 曲がり
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (indoor, 5 to 35 degC; the makers publish no operating temperature)

requirements.name: 水・ほこり (IP)
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer: drinks may splash on a restaurant robot)

requirements.name: 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

requirements.name: 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
requirements.basis: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

requirements.name: 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
requirements.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

requirements.name: 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

requirements.name: 1 本の電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (電線の外径の倍数、動かない所)
requirements.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1 Technical data: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V thin-wall PVC automotive cable, ISO 19642-3 class B). Static only: a cable that moves (to the steering or the suspension) is not covered; for moving flexible cords the Anixter catalogue page 02•67 (after BS 7540, cords up to 450/750 V, borrowed) gives 5D up to 12 mm and 6D above, read 2026-11-06

requirements.name: 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

requirements.name: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

requirements.name: 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

requirements.name: 弱い人がいるか
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 電池の端子から、最初に回路を守る器具までの電線の長さの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a): each ungrounded output conductor from a storage battery has a trip-free circuit breaker or fuse within 72 in (= 1828.8 mm, computed) of the battery, measured along the conductor (the cranking motor feed is excepted); 183.455(b) puts the device at the source of power, or within 7 in (177.8 mm), or within 40 in (1016 mm) if the conductor is sheathed, read 2026-11-06, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I (boats with gasoline engines). The longest of these is taken; a road-vehicle value was not checked

requirements.name: 積載
requirements.basis: Pudu BellaBot: 1 段 10 kg・計 40 kg, https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 荷の位置
requirements.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's own default value, not checked in any source. The height of the cargo's centre of gravity above the shelf it stands on, 150 mm (a cup or a plate on a tray); the demo vehicle's cargo is 150 mm above its deck as well. The shelf's own height is the design's, not this value

requirements.name: 液体のこぼれまでの余裕角
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer: a full cup spills at about 5 degrees of tilt)

requirements.name: 最高速度
requirements.basis: Pudu BellaBot, https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 加速
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer: 3 seconds from standing to 1.2 m/s, gentle for guests)

requirements.name: 停止距離
requirements.basis: the person's decision (11/7): stop distance 0.5 m -> 0.9 m, so the drinks' tilt in braking can stay within Q42

requirements.name: 止まっていられる坂
requirements.basis: assumption: the robot stays still on the steepest slope it is allowed to drive on, the 1/12 (= 8.33 %) of Q13 (バリアフリー法施行令 第19条, read 2026-11-03 in a source check); that parking uses the same slope is HIRAKU's choice

requirements.name: 稼働時間
requirements.basis: 各社の稼働時間 9〜18 h の下の側, https://www.keenon.com/en/product/T9 ほか; the range 9-18 h read 2026-11-03 in a source check (Keenon)

requirements.name: 充電時間
requirements.basis: Pudu BellaBot, https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 最小回転半径の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the 12 m of a motor vehicle on a public road and of the design vehicle of a forest road, applied to a vehicle on private land. 道路運送車両の保安基準 第 6 条第 1 項 (最小回転半径は、最外側のわだちについて 12 m 以下), read 2026-11-05 in the e-Gov law text (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). 林業専用道作設指針 (林野庁長官通知 平成 22 年 9 月 24 日 22林整整第 602 号) 第 3 の 1 (設計車両 普通自動車 最小回転半径 12 m) と 6 (曲線半径は原則 12 m 以上), read 2026-11-05 (https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/j/seibi/saisei/pdf/rinngyousenyou.pdf). The narrower curves of the 林道規程 (design speed 20 km/h: class 1 15 m, class 2 12 m, class 3 6 m) come from the 森林総合研究所 Q&A (https://www.ffpri.go.jp/qa/management/qa-manage3.html), a secondary page; the text of the 林道規程 was not checked

requirements.name: 荷と荷台の床のあいだの摩擦係数 (止まっているときの値)
requirements.basis: assumption: the container and road rule borrowed. CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7, 2.2.2.3 and the note of Appendix 2: a material pair not in the table or not verified, max 0.3; frost, ice, snow 0.2; oily or greasy 0.1, read 2026-11-06 (p. 95-96, p. 129). Pairs in Appendix 2 (p. 128-129, read 2026-11-06): sawn timber vs plywood 0.45, plastic pallet vs stainless steel 0.15, rubber vs other materials 0.6, and others listed in .notes/R3-sources.md. The same table is quoted from EN 12195-1:2010 Annex B in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) Appendix 3, read 2026-11-06 (secondary). Values for swept clean surfaces, static friction

requirements.name: 静的に倒れない限界
requirements.basis: assumption (満載で 10 度。製品の登坂の定格は 5 度以下、JARI の走行路は 10 度)

requirements.name: 安全率 (降伏に対して)
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 人に当たったときの力
requirements.basis: ISO/TS 15066 の体のモデルの表を載せた論文, Table 1, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2311.13814; read 2026-11-03 in a source check. The table's quasi-static values by body part (lower leg 130, thigh 220, chest 140, head 130 N) are borrowed from industrial robots (not a standard's value for a serving robot); 130 N is the smallest of them (computed: min), the safe side for one number

requirements.name: 挟み込みの隙間
requirements.basis: ISO 13854:1996 の試し読み, Table 1, https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: なぞる規格
requirements.basis: ISO 13482 の要旨 https://www.iso.org/standard/53820.html. Secondary: seen only in search summaries on 2026-11-03 (iso.org returned 403); the standard itself not checked in this repository

requirements.name: 電池の規則
requirements.basis: UN 試験・基準マニュアル Rev.5 (2009) の第三者の写し (読めたのは旧版), https://certifico.com/component/attachments/download/748; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 電池の電圧
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer: a 24 V battery pack)

requirements.name: 横の加速度
requirements.basis: computed: v^2 / (R g) = (1.2 m/s)^2 / (3 m x 9.80665 m/s^2) = 0.049 g, the sideways acceleration of the tightest turn the file allows (Q50 1.2 m/s, Q58 3 m). That the design's inertia loads use it is HIRAKU's choice (assumption); the vehicle's value is not borrowed

requirements.name: 前後の加速度
requirements.basis: a = v^2 / (2 s g) = 1.2^2 / (2 x 0.9 x 9.80665) (Q50, Q52 = the person's decision 0.9 m); was 0.147 g from Q52 0.5 m

requirements.name: 材料と接合
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 出荷の形
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 走行距離 (疲労)
requirements.basis: computed: Q03 10 h a day for 5 years, at Q50 1.2 m/s (4.32 km/h) with the robot never standing still: 43.2 km x 365 x 5 = 78 840 km (an upper bound; HIRAKU's choice). The hours and the years are Q03's assumption

requirements.name: 運転時間
requirements.basis: assumption

text: 確かめる分野を 7 つ、試験を 23 個選びました

data.want: 飲食店で料理と飲み物を運ぶ配膳ロボットを作りたい。お客さんのすぐそばを歩く速さで動き、飲み物をこぼさないようにしたい

picks.reason: 置・走 に当てはまるので、S1 静的な転倒 (傾斜台・縁の荷重)・S2 旋回での転倒 (J ターン・定常円)・S4 制動と前のめり・S6 小回り (最小回転半径) を当てる。S2 旋回での転倒 (J ターン・定常円) は Claude が荷重条件を書く
走・池 に当てはまるので、P1 段差を越える・P2 坂を登る・坂で発進する・P3 加速・最高速度・P4 航続・稼働時間 を当てる
液・走 に当てはまるので、F3 液体のこぼれ を当てる。F3 液体のこぼれ は Claude が荷重条件を書く
近・走 に当てはまるので、C2 人との接触 を当てる。C2 人との接触 は Claude が荷重条件を書く
荷・走・池 に当てはまるので、R1 静的強度・R2 衝撃 (落錘・落下・段差)・R3 疲労・耐久・R6 電池の取付の振動・R8 荷重の通り道 (部品と乗員の重さと加速度を枠まで伝える) を当てる。R2 衝撃 (落錘・落下・段差)・R6 電池の取付の振動 は Claude が荷重条件を書く
振 に当てはまるので、N1 固有振動数と加振 を当てる
池・続・電 に当てはまるので、T1 電池の温度・T2 モーター・制御器の温度 を当てる

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「板金の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 曲げの内側の半径は板厚以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb in sheet-metal design guides (inside bend radius not smaller than the sheet thickness); no single primary source was read (assumption)

rules.text: 穴の中心から板の縁までの距離は板厚の 2 倍以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb in sheet-metal design guides (hole centre to edge at least twice the thickness); no single primary source was read (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「締結の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: ボルト穴の中心から縁までの距離は穴径の 1.2 倍以上
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 3.5(1) and Table 3.3 (printed p. 23): minimum end distance e1 = 1.2 d0 and minimum edge distance e2 = 1.2 d0; 1.5 Symbols (p. 13): d0 = hole diameter, e1/e2 measured from the centre of the fastener hole to the adjacent end/edge (e1 in the direction of load transfer, e2 at right angles to it). Maximum e1, e2 = 4t + 40 mm for steel exposed to weather, larger of 8t or 125 mm for unprotected EN 10025-5 steel, otherwise unlimited (note 1). Fatigue: see EN 1993-1-9 (3.5(2)). Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 25 and p. 15), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf

rules.text: 鋼どうしのねじのかみ合い長さは呼び径以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb for steel screwed into steel; no single primary source was read (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「溶接の決まり」から 5 件の規則

rules.text: 溶接する角形鋼管の外形 (b, h) は肉厚の 35 倍以下
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 7.5.1 and Table 7.8 "Range of validity for welded joints between CHS or RHS brace members and RHS chord members" (printed p. 116): RHS braces bi/ti <= 35 and hi/ti <= 35 (tension; in compression also Class 1 or 2 for T, Y, X and K/N gap joints, Class 1 for overlap joints); RHS chord b0/t0 <= 35 and h0/t0 <= 35 and Class 1 or 2 for T, Y, X and K/N gap joints (overlap joints: Class 1 or 2 only). Outside the range all failure modes of 7.2.2 and secondary moments are to be considered (7.5.1(3)). The limit 35 holds for rectangular sections only; circular tubes are WD-03 (Table 7.1). The check does not look at the section class. Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 118), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf

rules.text: すみ肉溶接の長さは、のど厚の 6 倍と 30 mm の大きい方以上
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 4.5.1(2) (printed p. 42): a fillet weld whose effective length is less than 30 mm or less than 6 times its throat thickness, whichever is larger, is not to be designed to carry load. The length meant is the effective length l_eff (4.5.1(1): the length over which the fillet is full size; may be taken as the overall length minus 2a, no reduction if full size including starts and ends); a = effective throat thickness (4.5.2), itself at least 3 mm (4.5.2(2)). Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 44), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf

rules.text: 溶接する円形鋼管の外径は肉厚の 50 倍以下
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8:2005 (incorporating corrigenda Dec 2005 and Jul 2009), 7.4.1 and Table 7.1 "Range of validity for welded joints between CHS members" (printed p. 108): chord 10 <= d0/t0 <= 50 ("generally"; the scan prints "but:" and nothing after it), brace in tension di/ti <= 50, members in compression Class 1 or 2; Table 7.8 (printed p. 116) also gives di/ti <= 50 for a circular brace in tension on a rectangular chord. Read 2026-11-03 in the public.resource.org scan of BS EN 1993-1-8:2005 (PDF p. 110 and 118), hosted at https://www.phd.eng.br/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/en.1993.1.8.2005-1.pdf. The check is the upper limit 50 only: the lower limit 10 for chords, the section class and the exception behind "but:" are not checked. The limit was 35 for every tube before 2026-11-03; 35 is the rectangular one (WD-01)

rules.text: 角形鋼管を突き当てる T・L の継ぎ手は、全周を溶接する
rules.basis: assumption: the author's practical experience (a CAE practitioner's judgement); no document was read for this rule. A butt joint of a square tube is a T joint (an end meets the side of another tube) or an L joint (two ends meet); all round means the weld closes the whole perimeter of the cut end. The design says it with the node's weld_extent (all_round or partial); a node without it makes the rule not evaluable, it does not pass

rules.text: 力がかかる角形鋼管の T・L の継ぎ手には、ガセットを付ける
rules.basis: assumption: the author's practical experience (a CAE practitioner's judgement); no document was read for this rule. Every T and L butt joint of the frame is taken as one that carries force: how much force each joint carries is not computed here. A joint has a gusset when a part of kind gusset is carried by its node (carried_by). A tube that goes on past a node (another tube straight on the other side) is not butted there; a cross member that passes through the wall of a rail is not told from a butt joint and counts as one

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「公差の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 組み合う部品の隙間は、公差の積み上げより大きい
rules.basis: ordinary tolerance-stack practice (assumption); no single primary source was read

rules.text: 固定のボルトの位置の公差は、(隙間穴の径 - ボルトの径) / 2 以内
rules.basis: Fixed-fastener formula T = (H - F)/2 as given in Goodheart-Willcox, "GD&T: Application and Interpretation", 7th ed., p. 308 (secondary source; the ASME Y14.5 text itself was not opened). There T = position tolerance applied to all holes (the value in the feature control frame, at MMC), H = MMC size of the clearance holes (smallest hole), F = MMC size of the fastener (largest fastener). So clearance_hole_mm is the smallest clearance-hole diameter and bolt_diameter_mm the largest bolt diameter. Condition: holds only if the fixed (threaded / press-fit) feature carries a projected tolerance zone or the clearance-hole part is very thin. Floating fasteners (clearance holes in all parts) use T = H - F instead (same book, same page). Read 2026-11-03 in a saved copy of https://www.g-wonlinetextbooks.com/gdt-application-and-interpretation-2021/324 (printed page 308)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「人の決まり」から 7 件の規則

rules.text: 座面の幅は、座位殿幅 (若年女性 95 %) 391 mm 以上
rules.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, item J2 座位殿幅:足底支持 (hip breadth, sitting, feet supported), statistics table https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/gif/J2.gif (from https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html): young adults, female, 95th percentile 391.0 mm (N 202). Young adults = 18-29 years, women measured July-August 1992 (https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/index.html, section 1.2-1.3). The elderly female 95th percentile is 391.4 mm, so the limit also covers that group to within 1 mm. Read 2026-11-03

rules.text: 座面の奥行きは、座位殿・膝窩距離 (若年女性 5 %) 406 mm 以下
rules.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, item J6 座位殿・膝窩距離 (buttock-popliteal length, sitting), statistics table https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/gif/J6.gif (from https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html): young adults, female, 5th percentile 406.0 mm (N 202). Young adults = 18-29 years, women measured July-August 1992 (https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/index.html, section 1.2-1.3). The limit holds for that group only: the elderly (60+) female 5th percentile in the same table is 391.2 mm. Read 2026-11-03. The seat box may include the back, so a hit is a question to the designer, not a verdict

rules.text: 動いて閉じる隙間は、指が入る 25 mm より小さくしない
rules.basis: ISO 13854:1996, 4.2 Table 1 (minimum gap a: finger 25 mm; hand/wrist/fist 100, arm 120, toes 50, foot 120, leg 180, head 300, body 500), iTeh sample p.3 (PDF p.7), https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf , read 2026-11-03. Condition (4.1 b): if a larger body part can foreseeably enter the crushing zone, the gap for the largest part applies, so 25 mm is a floor only for zones that admit nothing larger than a finger; children and bulky clothing must also be considered. The current edition is ISO 13854:2017 (2nd ed., a "minor revision" per its foreword, ANSI preview read 2026-11-03); its Table 1 was not reachable (the preview stops before clause 4), so the 2017 finger value is not checked

rules.text: 人が乗る座席は、頭を後ろから受け止める上端が、座席の基準点から胴の線に沿って 800 mm 以上の高さにある
rules.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN Regulation No. 17, 08 series (MLIT text, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.6.2 (front seats not less than 800 mm) and 6.5.4 (from the R point to the tangent at the top, along the torso reference line), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1; 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.1(a)(1) (800 mm, from the H-point parallel to the torso reference line, S3), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles. A seat with no head support has no value and is reported as not given, not as passing

rules.text: 頭を受け止める面の左右の幅は、上端から 65 mm 下で 170 mm 以上
rules.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN R17 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.11 (85 mm to each side of the median plane, 170 mm computed) and 6.6.1 (plane 65 mm below the top), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1; 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.2 (not less than 170 mm at 65 ±3 mm below the top), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles

rules.text: 座った人の頭の後ろと、頭を受け止める面との水平のすき間は 55 mm 以下
rules.basis: assumption: a US passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.3 (front outboard backset not more than 55 mm) and S3 (backset measured from the rear of the head of a seated 50th percentile male, SAE J826 manikin with the head restraint measurement device), eCFR current text, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.202a, read 2026-11-06, for passenger cars and MPVs, trucks and buses of 4,536 kg GVWR or less. UN R17 08 series has no backset limit (read 2026-11-06)

rules.text: 背もたれと頭を受け止める部分のあいだのすき間は、165 mm の球で測って 60 mm 以下
rules.basis: assumption: a passenger-car value borrowed for a small open off-road vehicle. UN R17 08 series (https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R017.pdf) para. 5.8 (not more than 60 mm for a head restraint not adjustable for height) and 6.7.1 (165 mm sphere), read 2026-11-06, for M1 and N1; 49 CFR 571.202a S4.2.4.1 (no gap greater than 60 mm, 165 mm sphere), eCFR current text, read 2026-11-06, for US passenger cars and light vehicles

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「電池の決まり」から 13 件の規則

rules.text: 使う気温の高い側は、LiFePO4 セルの上限 55 degC 以下
rules.basis: EVE Energy LF50K Product Specification, file LF50K-73103 version D (2019-12-02), sec. 3 Nominal Technical Parameter, row 7 charge temperature 0-55 degC and row 8 discharge temperature -20-55 degC (row 9 storage: 1 month -20-45 degC, 1 year 0-35 degC), https://www.rcscomponents.kiev.ua/datasheets/LF50K32V50AhProduct%20Specification.pdf (a distributor's copy of the maker's specification); read 2026-11-03. 55 degC is the upper limit for both charging and discharging, i.e. for use; storage limits are lower and are not checked here. Q19 is the hot end of the range of use, so this is a first screen; the thermal tests (T1) judge the cell temperature itself

rules.text: 電池の電圧は 60 V (直流) 以下。超えると高電圧の扱いが要る
rules.basis: UN Regulation No. 100 (02 series of amendments), MLIT English/Japanese text, para. 2.17: "High Voltage" is a working voltage > 60 V and <= 1500 V DC (or > 30 V and <= 1000 V AC rms); para. 2.38: the working voltage is the highest voltage the maker specifies in open circuit or normal operation (so the full-charge voltage, not the nominal one), https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R100.pdf; read 2026-11-03. This text says "High Voltage", not "voltage class B". R100 Part I itself covers M and N1 vehicles above 25 km/h; the rule uses its 60 V DC line as the threshold for high-voltage handling on any vehicle

rules.text: 電線に続けて流す電流は、その電線が流してよい電流 (束ねてあれば束の割合をかけたもの) 以下
rules.check: (wire_bundle_count <= 1 and wire_current_A <= wire_rated_current_A) or wire_current_A <= req_Q23 * wire_rated_current_A
rules.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables": approximate current by conductor size for a single cable isolated in free air at 40 degC ambient, 90 degC and 105 degC conductor temperature, and rating factors for grouped touching cables (2: 0.80 .. 8: 0.50), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). wire_rated_current_A is the single-wire value of the cable maker's table at the ambient of R4-01 and the cable's temperature class; the code that gives it names the table in the declared basis. A table for another class (DIN VDE 0298-4 via Lapp T12, 33 CFR 183 Table 5 for boats) is borrowed and makes the hit trust 3

rules.text: 回路を守る器具 (ヒューズ・ブレーカ) の定格電流は、守る電線が流してよい電流を超えない
rules.check: wire_fuse_rating_A <= req_Q24 * wire_rated_current_A and (wire_bundle_count <= 1 or wire_fuse_rating_A <= req_Q24 * req_Q23 * wire_rated_current_A)
rules.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48 (a breaker opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded), https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf, read 2026-11-06. 33 CFR 183.455(c) (boats: not above 150 % of Table 5 under 50 V, not above 100 % at 50 V or more), https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I, read 2026-11-06. ISO 8820 and ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 / 7.2 (overload and short-circuit protection, seen only as titles in the table of contents) not checked

rules.text: 回路を守る器具の定格電流は、ふだん流れる電流以上 (ふだんの使い方で切れない)
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a device rated below the continuous current opens in normal use and the consumer gets no electricity); not taken from a standard. The time-current curve of the device (start-up and motor peaks) is not judged here

rules.text: 電線の被覆の温度クラスの上限は、電線が通る場所のいちばん高い周りの温度以上
rules.basis: The classes: IS/ISO 6722:2006 (identical with ISO 6722:2006) Table 1, A -40 to 85 degC, B -40 to 100 degC, C -40 to 125 degC, D -40 to 150 degC, E -40 to 175 degC, F -40 to 200 degC, G -40 to 225 degC, H -40 to 250 degC, https://archive.org/details/gov.in.is.iso.6722.2011, read 2026-11-06 (ISO 6722-1:2011 not checked). The rule is borrowed (assumption): FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-124, wires rated so that the conductor stays within the wire specification maximum when the ambient and the heat rise of the current are counted, read 2026-11-06. This check counts the ambient only; the heat rise is in WR-01 (the rated current at that ambient). No clearance in mm from a motor, brake or hot cells was read

rules.text: 電線の定格の電圧は、電池のいちばん高い電圧以上 (60 V の電線は 60 V 以下の系だけ)
rules.basis: IS/ISO 6722:2006 (identical with ISO 6722:2006) 3.1: a 60 V cable is for road vehicle systems whose nominal system voltage is equal to or less than 60 V d.c. or 25 V a.c.; 3.2: a 600 V cable above that, up to 600 V; 4.1: above 60 V d.c. special care against mechanical stress, https://archive.org/details/gov.in.is.iso.6722.2011, read 2026-11-06. ISO 6722 says nominal system voltage; this check uses var_battery_voltage, the full-charge voltage of BT-02, which is the stricter. For the demo battery 16 x 3.65 V = 58.4 V (cell cut-off from the EVE LF50K specification, the source of BT-01), below 60 V

rules.text: 1 本で通す電線の曲げの内側の半径は、外径の 3 倍以上 (動かない所)
rules.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V automotive cable). Static installation only; a wire that moves with the steering or the suspension is not covered by this value

rules.text: 束ねた電線の曲げの内側の半径は、束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の 10 倍以上
rules.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117 (bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire), https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf, read 2026-11-06

rules.text: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔は 609.6 mm 以下 (管やダクトの中は除く)
rules.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146 (intervals not more than 24 in = 609.6 mm, computed, except in troughs, ducts or conduits), https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf, read 2026-11-06. No public road-vehicle value was found

rules.text: 板や縁を通り抜ける所で留めていない配線は、縁から 9.525 mm 以上離す (守りの輪を付ける)
rules.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115 (grommets where wires cannot be clamped, at least 3/8 in = 9.525 mm, computed, from structure at penetrations), https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf, read 2026-11-06; 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats: protected from abrasion through a bulkhead or rigid surface, no number), read 2026-11-06

rules.text: 配線と、動かして操作する仕組みの隙間は 12.7 mm 以上
rules.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 dd and 11-125 (at least 1/2 in = 12.7 mm, computed, from controls under light hand pressure), https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf, read 2026-11-06

rules.text: 電池の端子から最初に回路を守る器具までの電線は 1828.8 mm 以下
rules.basis: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a) (within 72 in = 1828.8 mm, computed, of the battery, measured along the conductor), https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I, read 2026-11-06

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「組み立ての決まり」から 12 件の規則

rules.text: 1 人で持ち上げる部品は 23 kg 以下
rules.basis: Waters, Putz-Anderson, Garg, Fine, "Revised NIOSH equation for the design and evaluation of manual lifting tasks", Ergonomics 36(7):749-776, 1993, https://doi.org/10.1080/00140139308967940, sec. 6.2 (p.762) and Appendix A (LC = 23 kg / 51 lb), sec. 8.1 limitations (p.768-769); read 2026-11-03. The 23 kg is the load constant: the recommended weight limit at the standard lifting location (75 cm high, 25 cm out) under ideal conditions (all six multipliers = 1: sagittal, occasional, good coupling, short travel). The equation reduces it for real postures and frequencies; it is for two-handed lifting and not for one-handed, seated/kneeling or constrained-space lifts. This rule uses the 23 kg as the one-person limit for any lift, which is the most lenient value the equation allows. A hit means two people or a lifting aid are needed

rules.text: 部品の箱は地面より下に出ない
rules.basis: a check of the geometry (the origin is on the ground), not taken from a source (assumption)

rules.text: 上から押さえる固定 (荷の上を越える帯) の張りと床の摩擦で、荷が横へ滑らない
rules.check: 2 * topover_count * req_Q59 * lashing_angle_sin * lashing_pretension_N >= mass_kg * 9.80665 * (req_Q75 - req_Q59 * 1) * 1.1
rules.basis: EN 12195-1:2010 equation 10 (top-over lashing against sliding, m = n · 2 · μ · sin α · FT / (g · (cx,y − μ · cz) · fs)), as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 6.1.2, read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 46, https://www.hsa.ie/eng/Vehicles_at_Work/Load_Securing/Guidance_and_Publications/2014_European_Best_Practice.pdf); EN 12195-1 itself not checked (paid). The same balance without a safety factor is the CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7 4.2.7-4.2.8, read 2026-11-06 (p. 113-114). Borrowed from goods road vehicles (assumption). The guidelines (top-over lashing section, PDF p. 43) take FT as the STF and say the tension can fall to 50 % on deformable goods

rules.text: 荷が前へ滑らない (荷台の前の壁で止まるか、上から押さえる固定と摩擦で止まる)
rules.check: cargo_blocked_forward >= 1 or 2 * topover_count * req_Q59 * lashing_angle_sin * lashing_pretension_N >= mass_kg * 9.80665 * (req_Q76 - req_Q59 * 1) * 1.25
rules.basis: EN 12195-1:2010 equation 10 with fs = 1.25 forward, as quoted in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) 6.1.2, read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 46); blocking counts as securing (guidelines 1.4, PDF p. 14; CTU Code Annex 7 4.2.8, read 2026-11-06). Whether the front wall itself is strong enough is not checked by this rule (the CTU Code 6.6 gives front wall strengths for goods vehicles only). Borrowed (assumption)

rules.text: 上から押さえる固定の張りと床の摩擦で、荷が後ろへ滑らない
rules.check: 2 * topover_count * req_Q59 * lashing_angle_sin * lashing_pretension_N >= mass_kg * 9.80665 * (req_Q76 - req_Q59 * 1) * 1.1
rules.basis: EN 12195-1:2010 equation 10 with fs = 1.1 rearward, as quoted in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) 6.1.2, read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 46). A rear gate that blocks the load is not counted here. Borrowed (assumption)

rules.text: 摩擦が十分でも、荷は少なくとも 1 本の固定で止め、前で止まらない 1.52 m を超えるか 500 kg を超える荷は 2 本以上で止める
rules.check: lashing_count >= 1 and (lashing_count >= 2 or cargo_blocked_forward >= 1 or (size_x_mm <= 1520 and mass_kg <= 500))
rules.basis: 49 CFR 393.110(b)-(c) (not blocked forward: 1 tiedown for an article of 1.52 m or less and 500 kg or less, 2 for a heavier one or one up to 3.04 m; blocked: 1 per 3.04 m), read 2026-11-06 in the Cornell LII copy (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/49/393.110); CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) 5.4 and Annex 7 4.2.8 (mass and friction alone do not secure a load against vibration; a minimum number of top-over lashings is needed, no number given), read 2026-11-06 (p. 21, p. 114). The check covers loads up to 3.04 m long only (a longer one needs more). For commercial motor vehicles on public roads, borrowed (assumption)

rules.text: 固定の使ってよい力の合計 (荷の向こう側へ回すものは全部、そうでないものは半分で数える) が、荷の重さの決めた割合以上
rules.basis: 49 CFR 393.106(d) (aggregate working load limit at least one-half the weight; counting by (d)(1)-(3)) and 393.108(a) (a tiedown's WLL is the lowest of its parts and its anchor points), read 2026-11-06 in the Cornell LII copy (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/49/393.106). For commercial motor vehicles on public roads, borrowed (assumption)

rules.text: 固定が荷を床へ押さえつける力が、荷の重さの決めた割合以上 (でこぼこ道で荷が浮かない)
rules.basis: 49 CFR 393.102(b) (downward force at least 20 percent of the weight when the article is not fully contained), read 2026-11-06 (LII copy); the vertical force of a top-over lashing 2 · FT · sin α from EN 12195-1 equation 10 as quoted in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) 6.1.2, read 2026-11-06 (secondary). The CTU Code Annex 7 4.2.7 takes 1.8 times the pre-tension for a vertical lashing instead of 2, read 2026-11-06 (p. 113). Borrowed from road vehicles (assumption); no rough-road value was found

rules.text: 固定の最初の張りは、その固定の使ってよい力の半分以下
rules.basis: CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7 2.4.4 (initial pre-tension never more than 50 % of the MSL) and 2.4.1 (the LC of national standards corresponds to the MSL), read 2026-11-06 (p. 99-100). For lashings in cargo transport units; taking the US WLL as the MSL is an assumption

rules.text: 荷台の固定点は、どの 1 か所も決めた力に耐える
rules.basis: EN 12640 as quoted in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) 2.6, Table 3 (3.5 to 7.5 t: 800 daN per lashing point), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); EN 12640 not checked. 49 CFR 393.104(c) asks anchor points to meet the 393.102 criteria and gives no number, read 2026-11-06. Borrowed for a lighter vehicle (assumption)

rules.text: 横へ倒れやすい荷 (重心の高さが幅の半分に比べて高い荷) は、上から押さえる固定で止める
rules.basis: CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7 4.3.1: securing against tipping is needed when cx,y · d ≥ cz · b, read 2026-11-06 (p. 114); the box centre is taken as the centre of gravity (assumption). Only that tipping is addressed is checked, not the size of the lashing (the EN 12195-1 tipping equation was not read). Borrowed (assumption)

rules.text: 前へ倒れやすい荷は、荷台の前の壁で止めるか、上から押さえる固定で止める
rules.check: req_Q76 * (center_z_mm - bottom_z_mm) < 1 * size_x_mm / 2 or cargo_blocked_forward >= 1 or topover_count >= 1
rules.basis: CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7 4.3.1 (tipping when cx,y · d ≥ cz · b), read 2026-11-06 (p. 114); box centre taken as the centre of gravity, and a front wall at least as high as the centre of gravity is assumed when cargo_blocked_forward is 1 (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「サスの決まり」から 6 件の規則

rules.text: サスのストロークは、通る段差の高さ (Q15) 以上
rules.basis: engineering assumption, not taken from a source; Q15 is the step height in mm

rules.text: 荷を載せた静的なたわみは、サスのストローク以内
rules.basis: engineering assumption: the whole mass is shared equally by the supports and the spring is linear, so the static deflection is load / stiffness

rules.text: 操舵の軸を折る所の折れ角は、どの 1 か所でも上限 (要件) 以下
rules.basis: assumption: the limit is the requirement item R1-01 (35 deg by default, the maximum operating angle of Borgeson single steering universal joints, "U-Joint & Shaft General Instructions" item 1), read 2026-11-06, https://sdda.semadata.org/Standard/Borgeson/JOINT_SHAFT_GENERAL.pdf). Going past it can make the joint bind (same item). The angle of a joint is the angle between the axes of the two shafts it joins

rules.text: 操舵の軸を 2 か所で折るなら、2 つの折れ角の差は 1 度以下
rules.basis: The two angles must be equal for an even output: Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, rule 1, read 2026-11-06 (https://theengineer.markallengroup.com/production/content/uploads/2012/05/universal_joints.pdf); NSK US 8,965,743 B2 (joint angle at the upper joint equal to that at the lower joint), read 2026-11-06 (https://patents.google.com/patent/US8965743B2/en). The allowed difference is the requirement item R1-03 (1 deg by default, borrowed from Spicer's rule 2 for vehicle propeller shafts, https://spicerparts.com/node/202, read 2026-11-06): an assumption for a steering shaft

rules.text: 操舵の軸を 2 か所で折るなら、2 つの継手の向き合わせ (位相) の正しい向きからのずれは 7 度以下
rules.basis: The right phase (inner forks in line when the shaft is bent in one plane): Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, rule 2, read 2026-11-06; ididit instructions 8000000021, PDF p. 5 step 4, read 2026-11-06 (https://static.speedwaymotors.com/pdf/4461216-INS.pdf), which adds that a wrong phase can give early wear or binding. The allowed error is the requirement item R1-04 (7 deg by default, the example of NSK US 8,965,743 B2, read 2026-11-06): an assumption

rules.text: ハンドルを一定に回したときの、車輪の側の回転の速さのむらは上限 (要件) 以下
rules.basis: The fluctuation of one joint, w_out/w_in = cos a / (1 - cos^2 t * sin^2 a), max 1/cos a, min cos a: Mustansiriyah University lecture note "universal joint", PDF p. 7-8, read 2026-11-06 (secondary, https://uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/5/5_2021_12_11!08_27_23_PM.pdf); output between w cos a and w sec a, at 5 deg +/-0.4 %, 7 deg +/-0.8 %, 10 deg +/-1.5 %: Huco Universal Joints catalogue section 2, PDF p. 2, read 2026-11-06. The limit is the requirement item R1-02 (10 % by default, the example allowable torque variation rate of NSK US 8,965,743 B2, read 2026-11-06): an assumption. This rule covers one joint as well, where UJ-02 and UJ-03 do not apply

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「製造の決まり」から 1 件の規則

rules.text: 角形鋼管の肉厚は、規格品の下限 1.6 mm 以上
rules.basis: JIS G 3466 table 5 (square) and table 6 (rectangular), read in the JISF committee draft of the revision dated 2024-12-20 (資料 16, PDF p.9-12), https://www.jisf.or.jp/business/standard/jis/documents/docs_kouzai_1600_JISG3466_20241220.pdf, and the maker's range table of 日鐵住金建材 角パイプ (STKR) 製造可能範囲 (catalogue p.4), https://www.ns-kenzai.co.jp/pdf/a1/u-kaku-eco_kikaku.pdf; read 2026-11-03. The thinnest wall in both tables is 1.6 mm (sides 40-75 mm square, and rectangles up to 125x40); larger tubes start thicker (80-100 square 2.3, 125 square 3.2, 150-300 square 4.5). Clause 8.1 lets other sizes be agreed between buyer and maker, so 1.6 mm is the lower limit of the listed sizes, not a ban. The issued standard (2015 edition with amendment, as used for data/sections/standard_tubes.json) was not reopened for this rule; the draft lists the same 112 sizes

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「系の決まり」から 10 件の規則

rules.text: 走る製品は、動力源 (kind が motor か engine の部品) から駆動輪 (actuation.drive が true の接地点) まで、トルクを伝える鎖 (connects_to の carries: torque) が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum for a self-propelled product (the driven wheels, support.actuation.drive, are reached from the motor or engine by links that carry torque); not taken from a standard

rules.text: 人が乗って走る製品は、ハンドル (kind が steering の部品) から操舵輪 (actuation.steer が true の接地点) まで、操舵の鎖 (connects_to の carries: steer) が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a steering input reaches every steered support). Steering equipment of road vehicles is regulated by UN Regulation No. 79, "Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to steering equipment" (in force 1 December 1988); its paragraph 1 (Scope) applies it to the steering equipment of vehicles of categories M, N and O, and paragraph 2.3 defines steering equipment as all the equipment that determines the direction of movement (steering control, steering transmission, steered wheels, energy supply if any). In that original text paragraph 1 also leaves out transmissions that are purely hydraulic or electric at any point (except auxiliary steering equipment). Read in the original text, United Nations Treaty Series vol. 1519, A-4789 (https://treaties.un.org/doc/Publication/UNTS/Volume%201519/volume-1519-A-4789-English.pdf), and the UN Treaty Collection status page XI-B-16-79, read 2026-11-03. The current text (04 series of amendments) was not opened; the rule does not take any value from the regulation

rules.text: 走る製品は、制動の入力 (kind が brake_pedal・brake_lever・brake_controller の部品) から制動する輪 (actuation.brake が true の接地点) まで、制動の鎖 (connects_to の carries: brake) が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a brake input reaches every braked support). Braking of road vehicles is regulated. UN Regulation No. 13-H, "Uniform provisions concerning the approval of passenger cars with regard to braking": paragraph 1.1 applies it to the braking of vehicles of categories M1 and N1, and paragraph 1.2 leaves out vehicles with a design speed not over 25 km/h and vehicles fitted for invalid drivers (read in MLIT's English/Japanese text, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R013H.pdf). Japan's 道路運送車両の保安基準 (昭和26年運輸省令第67号) 第12条 (制動装置), paragraph 1: a motor vehicle must have two or more braking systems (二系統以上) meeting the braking performance set by 告示; one system is enough for vehicles with a maximum speed under 25 km/h, large special vehicles under 35 km/h and small special farm vehicles (read in the e-Gov 法令 XML, law id 326M50000800067, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). Both read 2026-11-03. The rule checks one connected brake chain, not the number of systems or their performance

rules.text: 人が乗る製品は、座席が骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a seat is joined to the frame by some chain of links)

rules.text: 人が乗る製品は、座席ごとに拘束 (シートベルトなど) が座席と骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (each seat has a restraint joined to the seat and to the frame). Road vehicles: 道路運送車両の保安基準 (昭和26年運輸省令第67号) 第22条の3 (座席ベルト等), paragraph 1, asks for seat belts and their anchorages (取付装置) on the seats listed in its table (a lap-and-shoulder 第二種座席ベルト on forward-facing seats of passenger vehicles under 10 seats, for example); two-wheelers, sidecar two-wheelers and vehicles under 20 km/h (other than large and small special vehicles) are left out, and so are some seat kinds (read in the e-Gov 法令 XML, law id 326M50000800067, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). Recreational off-highway vehicles: ANSI/ROHVA 1 (current edition 2023 per ROHVA, https://rohva.org/ansi-standard/, which lists an Occupant Retention System among its contents). The standard itself was not opened (sold); secondary: CPSC staff letter to ROHVA of 10 March 2011 on the canvass draft (section 11.1 Seat Belts asks for at least a three-point seat belt; https://www.cpsc.gov/s3fs-public/pdfs/blk_pdf_commcanvass03102111.pdf) and CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964 (19 Nov 2014), p. 68985-68986 (ANSI/ROHVA 1-2011 section 11.2 seat belt reminder, 11.3 ORS zones; ORS defined as including three-point seat belts; https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2014-11-19/html/2014-26500.htm). All read 2026-11-03

rules.text: 人が乗って屋外の悪路を走る製品は、乗員を囲む転倒保護の枠 (ROPS) が骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a roll-over protective structure is in the design and joined to the frame; that it encloses the occupants is not checked here). ANSI/ROHVA 1 (current edition 2023) lists a Roll Over Protective Structure (ROPS) among the requirements it covers (ROHVA's page, https://rohva.org/ansi-standard/); the CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964 (19 Nov 2014) describes ROVs as equipped with ROPS (p. 68964) and puts ROPS in its proposed ROV definition, 16 CFR 1422.2(a) (p. 69022) (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2014-11-19/html/2014-26500.htm). Read 2026-11-03. The standard text was not opened (sold): its ROPS clause number and test method were not seen, and ROHVA 1 covers ROVs only (in the NPR definition, among other features, a top speed over 30 mph)

rules.text: 公道を走る製品は、前照灯・尾灯・制動灯・方向指示器がそろう
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (one of each in the design). Lamps of road vehicles are regulated by Japan's 道路運送車両の保安基準 (昭和26年運輸省令第67号): 第32条 (前照灯等; 走行用前照灯 para. 1, すれ違い用前照灯 para. 4, on the front), 第37条 (尾灯), 第39条 (制動灯), 第41条 (方向指示器). 第37条 and 第39条 para. 1 ask for the lamp on both sides of the rear (one is enough for two-wheelers and vehicles 0.8 m wide or less) and do not apply to 軽自動車 and 小型特殊自動車 under 20 km/h; 第41条 para. 1 leaves out vehicles under 20 km/h shorter than 6 m with the driver's seat outside a cabin (and other listed conditions). Colour, brightness and mounting are left to the 告示 (not opened). Read in the e-Gov 法令 XML, law id 326M50000800067 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067), 2026-11-03. The design check counts one of each, not two per rear side

rules.text: 電池を積む製品は、電池からモーターまで、電力を伝える鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (the motors are reached from a battery by links that carry power)

rules.text: 電池を積む製品は、電力の鎖に遮断 (ヒューズかスイッチ) がある
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a fuse, switch, contactor or breaker is on the battery's power chain). Electrical safety of electric propulsion is the subject of ISO 6469-3:2021, "Electrically propelled road vehicles - Safety specifications - Part 3: Electrical safety" (edition 4, published 2021-10, stage 90.92 to be revised): per its abstract on the ISO catalogue page (https://www.iso.org/standard/81746.html, copy saved and read 2026-11-03), it covers voltage class B circuits of the propulsion system and conductively connected auxiliary systems, against electric shock and thermal incidents; post-crash is ISO 6469-4 and motorcycles and mopeds the ISO 13063 series. The text is sold and no preview was opened, so whether it requires a fuse, switch or other disconnect was not checked in this repository; the basis only says the standard covers the electrical safety of the propulsion system

rules.text: どの部品も、骨組みに止まっている (乗員と荷を除く。止め先の部材か節が、部品の箱から 500 mm 以内。500 mm は仮の値)
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (every part, people and cargo apart, is held by structural links, carries load or none, that reach a member, a node or a ground point of the frame; a link to a member counts only when the part's box is within 500 mm of it, a PROVISIONAL limit chosen here and not taken from a source; torque, steer, brake and power links pass a force on and do not hold a part). It finds a part drawn in the air whose connects_to says it is bolted on. Provisional: to be replaced by a load-path calculation (the force a part's weight and the road's acceleration put on its mount reaches the frame, and the deflection under a hand or foot load stays within the requirement); remove it then

data.want: 飲食店で料理と飲み物を運ぶ配膳ロボットを作りたい。お客さんのすぐそばを歩く速さで動き、飲み物をこぼさないようにしたい

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 段差に当たるときの速さ
requirements.basis: A design condition (HIRAKU's default value), set for the strength check of the step. It is not taken from a standard or a catalogue, so it has no outside source. What it gives, by the K2 calculation for the demo vehicle (offroad-4w-v1, two people and cargo): the front wheel force at the step is 3.6 times (100 mm step, 5.7 kN against 1.6 kN) to 4.4 times (250 mm step, 17.6 kN against 4.0 kN) the force of pushing up from rest

requirements.name: 路面・床と摩擦係数
requirements.basis: assumption: the friction coefficient between the wheel and a dry indoor floor (tile, wood, carpet), 0.5, HIRAKU's own value, not read in any source. The floors themselves are the ones of the JARI robot stability test facility's course, p.1, https://img.jari.or.jp/v=1740017440/files/user/pdf/stability_tests_of_robots_and_robotic_devices_2020.pdf; read 2026-11-03 in a source check (that page lists the surfaces, not a coefficient)
requirements.note: タイル・木・カーペットの床。摩擦係数は資料で確かめていない

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: an indoor floor (tile, wood, carpet) is taken as ISO 8608 class A, the smoothest class; not read in any source for floors (ISO 8608 is for roads). It is only the input the fatigue builder needs

requirements.name: 縦の坂
requirements.basis: バリアフリー法施行令の傾斜路 1/12 (= 8.33 %), 第19条, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1/lawdata/418CO0000000379; read 2026-11-03 in a source check. 製品の定格は 5 度以下 (Pudu BellaBot), https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot (this part not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: Bear Robotics Servi Plus の敷居 (1/2 in), Servi Plus page, https://www.bearrobotics.ai/servi-plus; read 2026-11-03 in a source check
requirements.note: 床の凹凸は LG CLOi ServeBot の 5 mm、ISO 7176-2 の試験は 15・25 mm も

requirements.name: 通る幅
requirements.basis: Keenon の製品ページの最小通路 (T8 0.55 m・T10 0.59 m・T9 0.70 m) の上の端, https://www.keenon.com/en/product/T9 (read 2026-11-03 in a source check; it recorded only the T9 page address). The earlier value 0.80 m is on none of the pages
requirements.note: 建物の廊下は 1.2 m 以上 (バリアフリー法施行令)

requirements.name: 曲がり
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (indoor, 5 to 35 degC; the makers publish no operating temperature)

requirements.name: 水・ほこり (IP)
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer: drinks may splash on a restaurant robot)

requirements.name: 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

requirements.name: 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
requirements.basis: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

requirements.name: 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
requirements.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

requirements.name: 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

requirements.name: 1 本の電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (電線の外径の倍数、動かない所)
requirements.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1 Technical data: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V thin-wall PVC automotive cable, ISO 19642-3 class B). Static only: a cable that moves (to the steering or the suspension) is not covered; for moving flexible cords the Anixter catalogue page 02•67 (after BS 7540, cords up to 450/750 V, borrowed) gives 5D up to 12 mm and 6D above, read 2026-11-06

requirements.name: 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

requirements.name: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

requirements.name: 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

requirements.name: 弱い人がいるか
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 電池の端子から、最初に回路を守る器具までの電線の長さの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a): each ungrounded output conductor from a storage battery has a trip-free circuit breaker or fuse within 72 in (= 1828.8 mm, computed) of the battery, measured along the conductor (the cranking motor feed is excepted); 183.455(b) puts the device at the source of power, or within 7 in (177.8 mm), or within 40 in (1016 mm) if the conductor is sheathed, read 2026-11-06, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I (boats with gasoline engines). The longest of these is taken; a road-vehicle value was not checked

requirements.name: 最小回転半径の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the 12 m of a motor vehicle on a public road and of the design vehicle of a forest road, applied to a vehicle on private land. 道路運送車両の保安基準 第 6 条第 1 項 (最小回転半径は、最外側のわだちについて 12 m 以下), read 2026-11-05 in the e-Gov law text (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). 林業専用道作設指針 (林野庁長官通知 平成 22 年 9 月 24 日 22林整整第 602 号) 第 3 の 1 (設計車両 普通自動車 最小回転半径 12 m) と 6 (曲線半径は原則 12 m 以上), read 2026-11-05 (https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/j/seibi/saisei/pdf/rinngyousenyou.pdf). The narrower curves of the 林道規程 (design speed 20 km/h: class 1 15 m, class 2 12 m, class 3 6 m) come from the 森林総合研究所 Q&A (https://www.ffpri.go.jp/qa/management/qa-manage3.html), a secondary page; the text of the 林道規程 was not checked

requirements.name: 荷と荷台の床のあいだの摩擦係数 (止まっているときの値)

CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7, 2.2.2.3 and the note of Appendix 2: a material pair not in the table or not verified, max 0.3; frost, ice, snow 0.2; oily or greasy 0.1, read 2026-11-06 (p. 95-96, p. 129). Pairs in Appendix 2 (p. 128-129, read 2026-11-06): sawn timber vs plywood 0.45, plastic pallet vs stainless steel 0.15, rubber vs other materials 0.6, and others listed in .notes/R3-sources.md. The same table is quoted from EN 12195-1:2010 Annex B in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) Appendix 3, read 2026-11-06 (secondary). Values for swept clean surfaces, static friction

text: 選んだ試験のうち S2 旋回での転倒 (J ターン・定常円)、F3 液体のこぼれ、C2 人との接触、R2 衝撃 (落錘・落下・段差)、R6 電池の取付の振動、H2 手と工具が入るか、H4 挟み込み、G2 規格の項目に当てる は、荷重条件の作り方 (builder) がまだ無いので、この実行では見ません

回してある部品と斜めの部材は数えない
重なってよい深さはツールと同じ決まり

parts not turned (no rpy_deg) as their boxes, members along x, y or z as the box of their length and section; turned parts and slanted members left out (their axis-aligned box is far bigger than they are), so an overlap of one of them can be missed, never added
two boxes overlap by the smallest of their overlaps along x, y and z
what may overlap how far is the tool's rule (k4_geometry.model.allowance): the definition of an interference, not a calculation
入力は formula_inputs (analysis.h1_motion_calc) から写した
動くのは車輪とタイロッドだけ
車輪は支えの位置を通る縦の軸で回り、上下に行程の半分ずつ動く
only the wheels and the tie rods move (the tool also moves the knuckle, the brake and the other links of the corner)
the wheel turns about the vertical axis through the support's position, through -max_steer_angle to +max_steer_angle; it moves up and down by half the travel each way
the other bodies as in assembly.overlap_count (turned parts and slanted members left out); what is mounted to the moving part is the tool's rule (k4_geometry.model.mounted)

箱どうしの離れは形どうしの離れより大きくならない

the gap between the axis-aligned boxes round the two (a node's or a support's point for those): never more than the gap between the shapes, so a joint can be missed, never added
a joint touches when the gap is at most 2 mm; wires and hoses run between the two and are not counted

a part goes straight along one axis; a piece already overlapping it at rest is H1-interference's and does not stop it
boxes as in assembly.overlap_count; turned parts are not counted

requirements.name: 使う頻度・年数
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 段差に当たるときの速さ
requirements.basis: A design condition (HIRAKU's default value), set for the strength check of the step. It is not taken from a standard or a catalogue, so it has no outside source. What it gives, by the K2 calculation for the demo vehicle (offroad-4w-v1, two people and cargo): the front wheel force at the step is 3.6 times (100 mm step, 5.7 kN against 1.6 kN) to 4.4 times (250 mm step, 17.6 kN against 4.0 kN) the force of pushing up from rest

requirements.name: 路面・床と摩擦係数
requirements.basis: assumption: the friction coefficient between the wheel and a dry indoor floor (tile, wood, carpet), 0.5, HIRAKU's own value, not read in any source. The floors themselves are the ones of the JARI robot stability test facility's course, p.1, https://img.jari.or.jp/v=1740017440/files/user/pdf/stability_tests_of_robots_and_robotic_devices_2020.pdf; read 2026-11-03 in a source check (that page lists the surfaces, not a coefficient)
requirements.note: タイル・木・カーペットの床。摩擦係数は資料で確かめていない

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: an indoor floor (tile, wood, carpet) is taken as ISO 8608 class A, the smoothest class; not read in any source for floors (ISO 8608 is for roads). It is only the input the fatigue builder needs

requirements.name: 縦の坂
requirements.basis: バリアフリー法施行令の傾斜路 1/12 (= 8.33 %), 第19条, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1/lawdata/418CO0000000379; read 2026-11-03 in a source check. 製品の定格は 5 度以下 (Pudu BellaBot), https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot (this part not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: Bear Robotics Servi Plus の敷居 (1/2 in), Servi Plus page, https://www.bearrobotics.ai/servi-plus; read 2026-11-03 in a source check
requirements.note: 床の凹凸は LG CLOi ServeBot の 5 mm、ISO 7176-2 の試験は 15・25 mm も

requirements.name: 通る幅
requirements.basis: Keenon の製品ページの最小通路 (T8 0.55 m・T10 0.59 m・T9 0.70 m) の上の端, https://www.keenon.com/en/product/T9 (read 2026-11-03 in a source check; it recorded only the T9 page address). The earlier value 0.80 m is on none of the pages
requirements.note: 建物の廊下は 1.2 m 以上 (バリアフリー法施行令)

requirements.name: 曲がり
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (indoor, 5 to 35 degC; the makers publish no operating temperature)

requirements.name: 水・ほこり (IP)
requirements.basis: assumption (a sample answer: drinks may splash on a restaurant robot)

requirements.name: 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
requirements.basis: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

requirements.name: 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
requirements.basis: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

requirements.name: 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
requirements.basis: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

requirements.name: 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

requirements.name: 1 本の電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (電線の外径の倍数、動かない所)
requirements.basis: Coficab data sheet FLRY / FLRY sn, rev. AM 09.03.2022, page 1 Technical data: min. bending radius 3 x D (static), https://media.iewc.com/PublicAssets/SpecificationSheets/COF-2010-01-AM-FLRY---FLRY-sn.pdf, read 2026-11-06 (a manufacturer's data sheet, 60 V thin-wall PVC automotive cable, ISO 19642-3 class B). Static only: a cable that moves (to the steering or the suspension) is not covered; for moving flexible cords the Anixter catalogue page 02•67 (after BS 7540, cords up to 450/750 V, borrowed) gives 5D up to 12 mm and 6D above, read 2026-11-06

requirements.name: 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

requirements.name: 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

requirements.name: 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

requirements.name: 弱い人がいるか
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 電池の端子から、最初に回路を守る器具までの電線の長さの上限
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a): each ungrounded output conductor from a storage battery has a trip-free circuit breaker or fuse within 72 in (= 1828.8 mm, computed) of the battery, measured along the conductor (the cranking motor feed is excepted); 183.455(b) puts the device at the source of power, or within 7 in (177.8 mm), or within 40 in (1016 mm) if the conductor is sheathed, read 2026-11-06, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I (boats with gasoline engines). The longest of these is taken; a road-vehicle value was not checked

requirements.name: 積載
requirements.basis: Pudu BellaBot: 1 段 10 kg・計 40 kg, https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 荷の位置
requirements.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's own default value, not checked in any source. The height of the cargo's centre of gravity above the shelf it stands on, 150 mm (a cup or a plate on a tray); the demo vehicle's cargo is 150 mm above its deck as well. The shelf's own height is the design's, not this value

requirements.name: 液体のこぼれまでの余裕角

requirements.basis: Pudu BellaBot, https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.basis: assumption: the robot stays still on the steepest slope it is allowed to drive on, the 1/12 (= 8.33 %) of Q13 (バリアフリー法施行令 第19条, read 2026-11-03 in a source check); that parking uses the same slope is HIRAKU's choice

requirements.basis: 各社の稼働時間 9〜18 h の下の側, https://www.keenon.com/en/product/T9 ほか; the range 9-18 h read 2026-11-03 in a source check (Keenon)

requirements.name: 充電時間
requirements.basis: Pudu BellaBot, https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot; read 2026-11-03 in a source check

requirements.name: 最小回転半径の上限
requirements.basis: assumption: the 12 m of a motor vehicle on a public road and of the design vehicle of a forest road, applied to a vehicle on private land. 道路運送車両の保安基準 第 6 条第 1 項 (最小回転半径は、最外側のわだちについて 12 m 以下), read 2026-11-05 in the e-Gov law text (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). 林業専用道作設指針 (林野庁長官通知 平成 22 年 9 月 24 日 22林整整第 602 号) 第 3 の 1 (設計車両 普通自動車 最小回転半径 12 m) と 6 (曲線半径は原則 12 m 以上), read 2026-11-05 (https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/j/seibi/saisei/pdf/rinngyousenyou.pdf). The narrower curves of the 林道規程 (design speed 20 km/h: class 1 15 m, class 2 12 m, class 3 6 m) come from the 森林総合研究所 Q&A (https://www.ffpri.go.jp/qa/management/qa-manage3.html), a secondary page; the text of the 林道規程 was not checked

requirements.name: 荷と荷台の床のあいだの摩擦係数 (止まっているときの値)
requirements.basis: assumption: the container and road rule borrowed. CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7, 2.2.2.3 and the note of Appendix 2: a material pair not in the table or not verified, max 0.3; frost, ice, snow 0.2; oily or greasy 0.1, read 2026-11-06 (p. 95-96, p. 129). Pairs in Appendix 2 (p. 128-129, read 2026-11-06): sawn timber vs plywood 0.45, plastic pallet vs stainless steel 0.15, rubber vs other materials 0.6, and others listed in .notes/R3-sources.md. The same table is quoted from EN 12195-1:2010 Annex B in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) Appendix 3, read 2026-11-06 (secondary). Values for swept clean surfaces, static friction

requirements.name: 静的に倒れない限界

criterion.basis: each member's von Mises stress over its own material's yield / Q61 1.5 (largest of these ratios): アルミ合金 A6061-T6 276 MPa (44 members, not checked). Tolerance 0.3: as R7, HIRAKU's choice for the gap between a hand calculation and the frame's analysis (no source)

criterion.basis: H1: no two bodies overlap at rest, the driver's seat at either end of its slide too, beyond what the rule allows (welded joints, bolted mounts up to MOUNT_MM, the rest TOUCH_MM: k4_geometry.model.allowance)

load_cases.title: つながりが形の上で触れているか (つながる点 at_mm が両方の形の上、つながりの無い部品が無い)

criterion.basis: H1: every mechanical joint a part's connects_to names touches (gap at most 2 mm: the program management's figure; wires and hoses not counted), says where (at_mm) on both shapes within 2 mm, and no part is joined to nothing

load_cases.title: どの部品も、どこかの向きから入れられるか

criterion.basis: H5: every part of the design goes in, along some direction in some order (none shut in by what is there before it); the steps without the hands' way and out of reach (steps_without_tool_clearance, steps_out_of_reach) are shown in the results, not judged: the assembly tool's hands' way is its own rule with no source

load_cases.title: 旋回での転倒: 満載で定常円を回り、内側の輪が浮く横の加速度を見る
load_cases.basis: 満載 (two_cargo、Q40 の荷で重心が最も高い) で、最高速度 Q50 の定常円を回る。内側の輪が浮く (転倒の始まり) 横の加速度が、要件の横の加速度 Q75 以上であること。床の摩擦は Q11。Q75 の basis は回転半径 3 m を使うが、Q58 の値は 12 m で、Q75 は厳しい側の値 (確かめていない点として残す)。余裕の係数は要件に無いので掛けない (前提)。

text: S2 の荷重条件 S2-speed1.2mps「旋回での転倒: 満載で定常円を回り、内側の輪が浮く横の加速度を見る」を書きました。限度は tip_lateral_accel >= 0.049 g (Q75 0.049 g)。根拠: 満載 (two_cargo、Q40 の荷で重心が最も高い) で、最高速度 Q50 の定常円を回る。内側の輪が浮く (転倒の始まり) 横の加速度が、要件の横の加速度 Q75 以上であること。床の摩擦は Q11。Q75 の basis は回転半径 3 m を使うが、Q58 の値は 12 m で、Q75 は厳しい側の値 (確かめていない点として残す)。余裕の係数は要件に無いので掛けない (前提)。
